test_title: PYST 46: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

He __is in high spirits__ today.
solution:
The correct answer is Cheerful.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check each option:
 
 
• **Annoying**- Causing irritation or annoyance
 
• **Disturbed**- Very upset emotionally
 
• **Drunk**- Affected by alcohol to the extent of losing control of one's faculties or behaviour.
 
• **Cheerful**- Noticeably happy and optimistic.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate meaning of the idiom '**is in high spirits**' is '**cheerful**'.
 
• Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
 

 Idiom
 Meaning
 Example
 
 

 play (merry) hell with sth
 to seriously damage or confuse something
 The power cuts played hell with our computers.
 
 

 play (sth) by ear
 to play a piece of music by remembering the notes
 He did not need sheet music. He could play the piece by ear.
 
 

 play a joke/trick on sb
 to confuse someone or cause a problem for them
 Fate played a cruel trick on him when he was injured in his first game.
